trust_decision.summary: XMSS/XMSS^MT verify trusts that the caller-supplied signature buffer holds params->sig_bytes, with params taken from the public key's OID; the core verifier ignores smlen. The fix adds one per-variant length check in the generated wrapper.

landing_point.why: The per-variant verify wrapper that OQS_SIG_STFL_verify dispatches to receives signature_len and passes it on without checking it; it is the obvious place for a length check.

fix_sites.entry_point: OQS_SIG_STFL_verify (src/sig_stfl/sig_stfl.c:1032) -> sig->verify = OQS_SIG_STFL_alg_xmss<variant>_verify (37 variants via XMSS_ALG macro, e.g. src/sig_stfl/xmss/sig_stfl_xmss_sha256_h10.c:7)
fix_sites.module_kind: public API wrapper (macro-generated per parameter set)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/sig_stfl/xmss/sig_stfl_xmss_functions.c:73-84 (OQS_API OQS_SIG_STFL_alg_xmss_verify, declared src/sig_stfl/xmss/sig_stfl_xmss.h:704-705) and src/sig_stfl/xmss/sig_stfl_xmssmt_functions.c:74-80 (OQS_SIG_STFL_alg_xmssmt_verify, sig_stfl_xmss.h:719-720); the published fix did not touch either

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The generic family-level verify functions are internal helpers behind the per-variant wrapper. The variant wrapper's length constant 'matches the algorithm', so a public key whose OID names a different parameter set looks like a misuse or unsupported combination, not an attack surface.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Valid KAT signatures of the exact length_signature must still verify for all 37 variants. An over-broad fix (e.g. requiring signature_len >= sig_bytes + message, or rejecting by the wrong family's constant in the shared xmss/xmssmt helper) breaks legitimate verification of other parameter sets.

O6_input_shapes: signature_len shorter than the variant's length_signature (e.g. 10 bytes, fix.diff:51,82)
signature_len longer than length_signature (also rejected, since the check is !=)

O7_producer.where: src/sig_stfl/xmss/external/params.c:255 (xmss_parse_oid maps the public key's OID to params incl. sig_bytes), called from src/sig_stfl/xmss/external/xmss.c:124 and :240

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Public key OID differs from the variant object: the length check uses the variant's constant, but sig_bytes comes from the pk's OID, so an OID for a larger parameter set (e.g. h20, 2820 B, with an h10 object, 2500 B) still overreads.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: A pk that does not match the chosen algorithm looks like caller misuse, and the fix's own test uses a matching OID.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different directory (external/), 2 calls below the fix site

O8_uncovered_routes.route: XMSS^MT version of the OID mismatch: xmssmt_sign_open takes params from the pk's OID (h20_2 up to h60_12, 27688 B) regardless of the variant.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above; MT variants look like a neighbouring feature.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Exported family-level OQS_SIG_STFL_alg_xmss_verify / _xmssmt_verify pass signature_len straight to sign_open with no length check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Looks like an internal helper even though it is OQS_API in sig_stfl_xmss.h:705.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Core verifier explicitly ignores smlen and reads sm up to params->sig_bytes.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Vendored upstream reference code with the comment 'smlen is a constant'.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Keep the per-variant check but have sign_open compare against params.sig_bytes; a planted copy could check the OID's family only (xmss vs xmssmt) and not the exact variant.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The OID is parsed here, and a maintainer adding a bound would naturally use params, missing that the variant and the OID can disagree.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A wrapper-level length check on LMS verify that trusts the type codes in the pk over the variant constant.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same STFL wrapper layout; the LMS verify forwards signature_len to the HSS code.

O9_family: CWE-125 out-of-bounds read from an unvalidated length / parameter-identity mismatch (input validation)

O10_build.toolchain: CMake + gcc/clang; needs -DOQS_ENABLE_SIG_STFL_XMSS=ON (default OFF, .CMake/alg_support.cmake:1257); OpenSSL optional
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_sig_stfl.c (KAT-based correctness), tests/fuzz_test_sig_stfl_xmss.c (fuzz harness on OQS_SIG_STFL_verify, already in pinned tree); ASan needed to observe overread

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `if (signature_len != OQS_SIG_STFL_alg_xmss<v>_length_signature) return OQS_ERROR;` in the macro wrapper only, leaving the pk-OID-derived sig_bytes unchecked.

out_of_scope_notes: LMS verify (src/sig_stfl/lms/sig_stfl_lms_functions.c:625-634) passes signature_len to the HSS validator; not examined, different scheme.
Verify also does not bound public_key length (no pk_len parameter in API); out of this advisory's scope.
unverified: Overread size for the OID-mismatch route inferred from length constants (sig_stfl_xmss.h:70,104), not executed.
Whether a later upstream commit fixed the OID-mismatch route is unknown (no latest release given).
Whether the pinned fuzz harness (tests/fuzz_test_sig_stfl_xmss.c) already reports this flaw publicly; affects recall risk.
O1 counts the dispatcher route and the exported family-level verify; the 37 macro-generated variants are counted as one entry point.
